slices.focus: Summer back flare forces physical therapy, demo rotation, and honest workload limits
slices.summary: After a hot week of conduit pulls and standing instruction, Derek's chronic lower-back injury flares sharper than ever, forcing him to start physical therapy and accept strict lifting limits. He realizes he can no longer physically perform every shop demonstration himself and designs a three-category plan (things he still does, things he coaches but does not perform, things he fully hands off). Erin and his mother had been warning him about overcommitting, and the flare validates their concerns. He commits to pacing field work and instruction separately rather than pretending they are interchangeable.
